name: webflow-cms-binding-highlighter
description: Highlights Webflow CMS field bindings as inline pills in HTML, JSON, and JS files.

webflowCmsBindings.enabled.description: Highlight Webflow {{wf ...}} bindings in the editor.

webflowCmsBindings.displayMode.description: How Webflow bindings are displayed. 'pill' shows a decoded field-name pill while preserving the source text; 'highlight' keeps the encoded binding visible.

webflowCmsBindings.languages.description: Language IDs for which binding highlights are applied.

webflowCmsBindings.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before refreshing decorations after edits.

webflowCmsBindings.validate.enabled.description: Validate JSON-LD schema blocks while ignoring Webflow CMS bindings.

webflowCmsBindings.validate.severity.description: Diagnostic severity for schema.org type/property and missing required-property issues.

webflowCmsBindings.recommend.enabled.description: Show schema.org property completions and recommended-field quick fixes.

webflowCmsBindings.recommend.includeGoog.description: Include Google rich-result required and recommended fields in diagnostics and quick fixes.

commands.title: Webflow CMS Bindings: Toggle Pill Display
Webflow CMS Bindings: Insert Recommended Properties

scripts.build:schema: tsc scripts/build-schema-data.ts --module commonjs --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --outDir out/scripts --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node out/scripts/scripts/build-schema-data.js
